_note: Copied to .mcu-profile.json by /scaffold-mcu-project wch <part>. Full key reference: `mcu --schema`. Defaults target CH32V003 with a WCH-Link probe.

ch32v003._note: QingKe V2A. 16 KB flash / 2 KB SRAM. RV32EC has only 16 registers.

ch32v303._note: QingKe V4F — has a single-precision FPU, so mabi is ilp32f.

_flashTool_guidance.wlink: WCH-Link probe (USB 1a86:8010 / 8012). Flash, erase, reset and a GDB server.
_flashTool_guidance.wchisp: NO PROBE NEEDED — the factory USB ISP bootloader. Hold BOOT0 while plugging in USB. The fastest path for a board with no debug header.

hostTest: cmake -S . -B build-host -G Ninja -DHOST_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build-host && ctest --test-dir build-host --output-on-failure

_cmake_variant._note: Swap these in for a CMake project instead of a ch32fun Makefile. Gives you the same tasks.json/launch.json flow as the arm leaf.

_wchisp_variant._note: Probe-free flashing over the factory USB bootloader. Hold BOOT0 while connecting USB.
_wchisp_variant.debugServer: echo 'wchisp is a bootloader tool and has no debug server — use wlink with a WCH-Link probe.' && exit 1
